scripts.test:chrome: cross-env BROWSER=chromium cucumber-js --profile parallel --format json:reports/chrome-report.json --format html:reports/chrome-report.html
scripts.test:firefox: cross-env BROWSER=firefox cucumber-js --profile parallel --format json:reports/firefox-report.json --format html:reports/firefox-report.html
scripts.test:webkit: cross-env BROWSER=webkit cucumber-js --profile parallel --format json:reports/webkit-report.json --format html:reports/webkit-report.html
scripts.test:all-browsers: npm run test:chrome && npm run test:firefox && npm run test:webkit
